title: Incoming morphisms of a distinguished triangle form a cofiltered cofinal index category
statement: Let $\mathcal D$ be a pre-triangulated category [def-weil-triangulated-category] and let $S$ be a saturated multiplicative system compatible with its triangulated structure [def-pur-saturated-triangulated-localization]. For a distinguished triangle $(X,Y,Z,f,g,h)$, let $\mathcal I$ be the category whose objects are morphisms of triangles $(s,s',s''):(X',Y',Z',f',g',h')\to(X,Y,Z,f,g,h)$ from a distinguished triangle, with $s,s',s''\in S$, and whose morphisms $(X'',Y'',Z'')\to(X',Y',Z')$ are morphisms of triangles with all three components in $S$ compatible with the given morphisms to $(X,Y,Z,f,g,h)$. Then $\mathcal I$ is cofiltered, and each projection $\mathcal I\to S/X$, $\mathcal I\to S/Y$, and $\mathcal I\to S/Z$ is initial (the cofiltered form of cofinal).

proof.text: For each vertex projection, apply the corresponding clause of [lem-pur-triangle-completion-ms6-05r9] to an object t of S/X, S/Y, or S/Z. Package the resulting distinguished triangle and its denominator triangle map as an object of I. Its projected denominator has the same domain as t and its structure map equals t, so the identity on that domain gives a morphism from the projected object to t. This proves the existence condition in Mathlib Functor.initial_of_exists_of_isCofiltered for each of the three projections.

proof.text: The identity triangle morphism gives an object of I by MS1 of [def-pur-saturated-triangulated-localization]. Apply the finite-family clause of [lem-pur-triangle-common-refinement-ms3-05r9] to a Bool-indexed pair of objects and package its componentwise S-maps as arrows of I. Apply its equalization clause to parallel arrows; equality of the three component composites gives equality of triangle maps, then equality of the arrows of I by full-subcategory and restricted-over-category extensionality. These constructions give an IsCofiltered instance.

source.place: Derived Categories, Lemma Tag 05R9 proof, filteredness condition (2)

proof.text: Use Mathlib Functor.initial_of_exists_of_isCofiltered separately for all three projections. Existence is step 1. For two arrows a,b from the same projected object to a denominator d, their composites with d.hom agree by the over-category equations. The right-calculus MS3 clause of [def-pur-saturated-triangulated-localization] supplies v in S equalizing a.left and b.left by precomposition. Apply the corresponding vertex clause of [lem-pur-triangle-completion-ms6-05r9] to v and the source distinguished triangle. Compose its triangle map with the original structure map; MS1 puts all components in S. This gives an object x and an arrow t from x to the original object in I. On the chosen vertex, the component of t equals v, so the projected composites with a and b agree. Restricted-over-category extensionality proves the required arrow equality. The criterion combines this single-source equalization with the common predecessors from step 2, thereby proving initiality at each vertex without constructing rotation equivalences explicitly.

lean.statement: theorem triangle_morphism_category_cofiltered_initial {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [HasZeroObject C] [HasShift C ℤ] [Preadditive C] [∀ n : ℤ, (shiftFunctor C n).Additive] [Pretriangulated C] (S : MorphismProperty C) (hS : S.IsSaturatedMultiplicativeSystem) [S.IsCompatibleWithTriangulation] (T : Triangle C) (_hT : T ∈ distTriang C) : letI : S.HasLeftCalculusOfFractions := hS.1.1 let W : MorphismProperty (Triangle C) := S.inverseImage Triangle.π₁ ⊓ (S.inverseImage Triangle.π₂ ⊓ S.inverseImage Triangle.π₃) let P : ObjectProperty (W.Over W T) := fun x ↦ x.left ∈ distTriang C let p₁ : P.FullSubcategory ⥤ S.Over ⊤ T.obj₁ := { obj := fun x ↦ MorphismProperty.Over.mk ⊤ x.obj.hom.hom₁ x.obj.prop.1 map := fun f ↦ MorphismProperty.Over.homMk f.hom.left.hom₁ (Triangle.π₁.congr_map (MorphismProperty.Over.w f.hom)) map_id := fun _ ↦ rfl map_comp := fun _ _ ↦ rfl } let p₂ : P.FullSubcategory ⥤ S.Over ⊤ T.obj₂ := { obj := fun x ↦ MorphismProperty.Over.mk ⊤ x.obj.hom.hom₂ x.obj.prop.2.1 map := fun f ↦ MorphismProperty.Over.homMk f.hom.left.hom₂ (Triangle.π₂.congr_map (MorphismProperty.Over.w f.hom)) map_id := fun _ ↦ rfl map_comp := fun _ _ ↦ rfl } let p₃ : P.FullSubcategory ⥤ S.Over ⊤ T.obj₃ := { obj := fun x ↦ MorphismProperty.Over.mk ⊤ x.obj.hom.hom₃ x.obj.prop.2.2 map := fun f ↦ MorphismProperty.Over.homMk f.hom.left.hom₃ (Triangle.π₃.congr_map (MorphismProperty.Over.w f.hom)) map_id := fun _ ↦ rfl map_comp := fun _ _ ↦ rfl } IsCofiltered P.FullSubcategory ∧ p₁.Initial ∧ p₂.Initial ∧ p₃.Initial
